uncited: *   **Input:** Sparse Structure-from-Motion (SfM) point cloud $P \in \mathbb{R}^{M \times 3}$, camera poses $\{x_c\}$, and training images.
*   Learnable offsets: $O_v \in \mathbb{R}^{k \times 3}$, where $k$ is the number of neural Gaussians spawned per anchor.
*   MLP Architecture: All MLPs ($F_\alpha, F_c, F_q, F_s, F_w$) are 2-layer MLPs with ReLU activation.
Decode attributes in one-pass from $\hat{f}_v$, $\delta_{vc}$, and $\vec{d}_{vc}$ via MLPs $F_\alpha, F_c, F_q, F_s$.
Quantize neural Gaussians into multi-resolution voxels of size $\epsilon_g^{(m)} = \epsilon_g / 4^{m-1}$ for levels $m \in \{1, 2, 3\}$.
If $\nabla_g > \tau_g^{(m)} = \tau_g \cdot 2^{m-1}$, deploy a new anchor at the voxel center if none exists.
Accumulate opacity values of neural Gaussians associated with an anchor over $N$ iterations.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Storage requirements are significantly reduced as only anchor points and MLP predictors are stored per scene.
